name: Thor Hammer Time

features.name: Lightning Bonus
features.description: Multipliers, sticky wilds or wild reels.

review:
Thor from Nolimit's gentler early days, on 5x3. His Lightning Bonus symbol on reel 5 awards a multiplier, random sticky wilds or sticky wild reels.

Rune Raze randomly turns every rune into one type, and Hammer Time turns all the high symbols into Thor. Medium volatility, a 2,328x cap and a 33% hit rate. Easy-going.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
